data.gender_notes: Humphrey is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Old English name Humphrey is composed of two elements: 'hug' and 'freo'. The former means 'heart', while the latter translates to 'gracious' or 'dear'. This name is believed to have originated as a nickname for someone who displayed these qualities. The name Humphrey carries the meaning “Dear and Gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Humphrey usually hope their child will grow to embody dear and gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Humphrey total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
